verses.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.2: Give thanks to the God of gods. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.4: To the one who performs great wonders alone. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.5: To the one who made the heavens with understanding. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.6: To the one who set the earth on the waters. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.7: To the one who made the great lights. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.8: The sun to rule the day. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.9: The moon and stars to rule the night. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.10: To the one who struck Egypt in their firstborn. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.11: And brought Israel out from among them. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.12: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.13: To the one who split the Red Sea into sections. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.14: And led Israel through its midst. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.15: And cast Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.16: To the one who led his people through the wilderness. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.17: To the one who struck great kings. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.18: And killed mighty kings. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.19: Sihon, king of the Amorites. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.20: Og, king of Bashan. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.21: And gave their land as an inheritance. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.22: An inheritance to Israel, his servant. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.23: When we were brought low, he remembered us. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.24: And delivered us from our enemies. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.25: Who provides bread for all flesh. For his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.26: Give thanks to the God of the heavens. For his steadfast love endures forever.

notes:
Notes
- v. 22: "his servant" refers to Israel, reflecting the covenantal relationship between God and Israel.
- v. 26: "God of the heavens" is a direct translation of the Hebrew phrase, emphasizing God's sovereignty over creation.
